setlist.title: Going Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (3 reviews): Terrapin Station as the encore came as a surprise; Terrapin encore was completely unexpected, seen as a consolation prize for the short show [16][18][22]
- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Reviewer found Let It Grow phenomenal; First set was slightly above average, with Let It Grow and Black Throated Wind singled out as good [16][19]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 review): Reviewer thought Loser and Black Throated Wind were top notch [22]
- **Goin' Down the Road** (1 review): Reviewer recalled Black Throated Wind as great, with Goin' Down the Road and Good Lovin' rocking [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ramble On Rose**: cut on the recording [28]
- **Space**: cut on the recording [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-03-28.133617.Nak300s-Senn441s.Fitzy.Keo.Flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 136 min [1]
- **gd1991-03-28.sbd.miller.87732.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 15 songs; 136 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1991-03-28.146430.neuman-skm150.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: soundboard; 16 songs; 140 min [6]. Said about its sound: Set II has small patches of static in the right channel, mostly fixed [6]
- **gd91-03-28.fob-schoeps-mahoney-oneill.miller.28391.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 15 songs; 141 min; rated 2.4/5 by 5 [11]
- **gd91-03-28.sbd.barbella.7287.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 15 songs; 134 min; rated 3.14/5 by 14 [15]. Said about its sound: Decent soundboard, though not as hot as 3/27; second-set opening songs had blown changes and keyboardist seemed lost; Beginning of China Doll is cut on this recording; reviewer praised a double Jerry gem out of Space [19][20]

## Around the show

- Reviewer from Southampton suspected a band member had stomach trouble; both sets were very short and Jerry looked frustrated [18]
- Short sets guessed to stem from someone's intestinal trouble, with Terrapin encore as a bone to the crowd [20]
- Second set ended suddenly without warning, leaving the crowd bewildered; a stranger in the parking lot handed reviewer a balloon [21]
- Reviewer found the show short with no standout song, and called Terrapin the first encore of it in about 900 shows [23]
- Freezing night; nearby Days Inn was packed with deadheads holding open-door room parties [24]
- The previous night ran past the union midnight curfew, causing costly overtime teardown; Bobby was reportedly furious [26]
- Reviewer recalled a six-song first set, the shortest they had seen [26]
- Reviewer judged this show not as hot as the 3/27 show [19]
- Last Terrapin encore was 7-8-78 at Red Rocks; reviewer rated this better than 3/29/91 despite being shorter [20]
- First night was a classic Nassau show, but this second night was not [21]
- Show felt rushed at times, which helped songs like Let It Grow [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-03-28.133617.Nak300s-Senn441s.Fitzy.Keo.Flac2496**: taped by Fitzy; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Fitzy, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns + Sennheiser 441's> Unknown Radio Shack Mixer > Sony D5,Tapes:Maxell MX 90 +… [1]. Also: Fitzy recorded with Nak300CP4 and Senn441 mics into Sony D6, transferred from DSD files in 2015; Mr. Baker's patches fill a couple of minutes missing from the second-set tape flip [1]
- **gd1991-03-28.sbd.miller.87732.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) D [4]. Also: Front-of-board Schoeps CMC3/MK4 to DAT, then Samplitude, to CD; encore placed at end of disc one [4]
- **gd1991-03-28.146430.neuman-skm150.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: Source: (FOB) Neuman SKM150 (90 Deg X-Y) > Oade p/s > Panasonic SV255 > DAT (48K) - Taped by Tim Daltoneg: SBD > DAT [6]
- **gd91-03-28.fob-schoeps-mahoney-oneill.miller.28391.sbeok.shnf**: taped by JC Mahoney, Dan O'Neill; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: FOB Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF)> Oade Preamp> Dat (Panasonic SV255/48k) [11]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred DAT via Behringer sample-rate converter and Samplitude to SHN [11]
- **gd91-03-28.sbd.barbella.7287.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN (seekable) via Steve Barbella [15]
